research_question: Which parameterized extra-dimension models make distinguishable predictions across short-range gravity, colliders, gravitational waves, and cosmology?
scope: Theory-to-observable evidence synthesis and design-only research plan; no discovery claim is permitted.

subhypotheses.claim: A model-and-scale taxonomy prevents conflating mathematical dimensionality with an experimental detection claim.
prohibited_claims: String-theory dimensionality proves hidden dimensions occur in nature
All higher-dimensional models have the same observables

subhypotheses.claim: Each channel constrains a declared model-to-observable map rather than a universal number of dimensions.
prohibited_claims: A null result in one channel proves there are no extra dimensions

subhypotheses.claim: Cross-channel overlap and independent alternatives determine discovery-grade discriminability.
prohibited_claims: A single anomaly uniquely establishes an extra dimension

evidence_levels.A: Direct likelihood or published experimental/observational constraint within its analysis model
evidence_levels.U: Unverified metadata, unknown translation, or human-review-needed assumption
